narr: Some residual monsoonal moisture remained around the Rio Grande Valley of Texas with very weak flow aloft. Slow moving storms developed over northeast El Paso which dropped 1 to 2 inches of rain quickly causing some localized flash flooding.
ev: Six to 8 inches of water was over the road on Hondo Pass near Dyer. Two lanes of Dyer southbound had standing water as well.
lsr: SPOTTER EP558 REPORTED 6-8 INCHES OF WATER ON HONDO PASS REACHING OVER THE CURB AT SOME POINTS. 2 LANES ON DYER S. BOUND HAVE STANDING WATER AS WELL.
